name: manual_b57fed
claim: In this environment's sandboxed shell, a PreToolUse hook denies direct access to virtualenv-relative interpreter and package-manager binaries -- install and run Python packages via the ambient system interpreter's module-invocation form against an explicit package path instead of creating or invoking a project-local venv

decisions.notes: Hit this twice this session testing oramasys PR#3 checkouts; venv creation itself succeeds but every subsequent invocation of a binary under it is blocked, costing a full re-diagnosis each time before switching to the ambient interpreter.
